Regular Crops Probability Weight.Description: A relative probability weight for regular crops, bought from vendors with no restrictions.

Restricted Crops Probability Weight.Description: A relative probability weight for crops with minor restrictions, but can still generally be obtained in large numbers (limited stock, monster drops, dug up, Dwarf, Sandy, Suki, low/mid tier quest lines, during Community Center completion, etc).

Rare Crops Probability Weight.Description: A relative probability weight for crops with major restrictions (not purchasable with Gold, late game quest lines, Community Center completion, etc).

Unique Crops Probability Weight.Description: A relative probability weight for extremely unique or limited crops (Qi quests, single crop seeds per playthrough, seed maker banned, end game quest lines, post-Perfection, etc).

Unfamiliar Crops Probability Weight.Description: A relative probability weight for crops for which I don't know their unlock and availability requirements/restrictions because I'm unfamiliar with the mod.
